mainEntity.name: Do I need to hire a contractor for a double vanity installation, or can I do it myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it's possible for experienced DIYers to install a double vanity, complex installations involving plumbing modifications, electrical work, or structural changes are best handled by a professional contractor. A contractor ensures proper installation, adherence to local building codes, and can manage unexpected issues that arise, especially in older homes common in areas like Berkeley or Oakland. Attempting a complex installation yourself without adequate experience can lead to costly mistakes, water damage, or safety hazards. We provide expert installation to ensure your project is completed correctly and efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Complex double vanity installations involving plumbing, electrical, or structural changes are best left to a professional contractor to ensure proper installation and safety.
